name: objective-first
role: Gatekeeper skill: no nontrivial work starts until the main aim and objective are written as an Objective Card and confirmed.
core_rules: The aim is a sentence naming the change, the beneficiary, and the measure; a topic is not an aim.
A solution-shaped request is traced back to the problem it serves before building.
Deliverables without an objective above them are flagged.
The user owns the aim; the skill owns the questions.
One card per aim; multiple aims means multiple tasks.
workflow: 2 Ask the aim question: what should be different when this is done.
3 Separate aim, objective, deliverable; flag orphan deliverables.
4 Fill the Objective Card: aim, beneficiary, success criteria, non-goals, constraints, kill condition, first step.
5 Read back and challenge; contested aims route to self-debate.
6 Card goes at the top of the STATE file per Long_Task_Memory_Protocol.md.
7 Check every step and scope change against the card; renegotiate before off-card work.
8 Score completion against the card's success criteria, not effort.
constraints: A few focused questions; a gate, not an interrogation.
activation: start a project, new task, help me plan, where do I begin, solution with no stated problem, scope drift, do X with no why.
output_discipline: Terse by default. No contractions. No inline emphasis. No emojis. OUTCOME-LOG improvement loop.
